### Invisible But Not Insignificant
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-september-9-2026.html
Passage: John 7:37-38
Points:
- Physical invisibility should never be confused with weakness or insignificance.
- Jesus used the metaphor of living water to describe the Holy Spirit given to believers.
- Rather than a passive force, the Spirit within the believer is a dynamic, overflowing source of life.
- God's unseen Spirit actively works to transform believers and secure them for eternity.

### Are You Spiritually Thirsty?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-may-3-2024.html
Passage: John 7:37-39
Points:
- People frequently seek fulfillment through intellectual knowledge, religious busyness, or emotional highs.
- Merely accumulating facts or working tirelessly leaves the human heart empty and unsatisfied.
- Jesus invites anyone who feels parched and weary to come directly to Him.
- Lasting spiritual satisfaction comes only from drinking of Christ and receiving His Spirit.
